_comment: Round 1 (LLM analyst proposal; every term is only a candidate, the deterministic engine keeps it only if more quotes are reproduced to the yen). Generic terms read off quotes.csv and the frozen run's residuals: billed area (per-piece area rounded up to 0.1 m2, times quantity) and its tiers (volume discount); standard-board yield for rigid boards (pieces per 3x6 / 4x8 sheet, sheets needed); eyelets for banners (one per 500 mm of edge unless the remarks say no eyelets); yes/no conditions from the remarks that merge the wordings of one condition and drop the negated ones (rush, removal, disposal, site survey, night work, delivery), offered as threshold flags (keys / factors in the forward phase, not in the first rich model); site_town redefined so that a Hamamatsu address keeps its town and drops the ward (wards were renamed/merged in 2024, the same town appears under two spellings). Search settings: two of the four search variants start from a parsimonious forward model instead of the rich main-effects model (the rich model over every key x feature has more columns than the segments can pin down and used up the work budget in a first attempt), fewer mined keywords (the flags above cover the conditions) and a larger wall-clock safety cap so that the deterministic work budget, not CPU contention, ends the search.

derived.site_town: if_(contains(site, '浜松市'), concat('浜松市', regex(site, '区(.+)$', 1, '')), regex(site, '^\s*((?:東京都|北海道|(?:京都|大阪)府|.{2,3}?県)?.+?[市区町村])', 1, ''))
derived.removal: if_(contains(remarks, '撤去') and not contains(remarks, '撤去は別途'), 1, 0)
derived.disposal: if_(contains(remarks, '処分', '産廃') and not contains(remarks, '処分不要', '処分は先方'), 1, 0)
derived.survey: if_(contains(remarks, '現調', '現地調査') and not contains(remarks, '不要'), 1, 0)
derived.no_eyelets: if_(contains(remarks, 'ハトメ不要', 'ハトメなし'), 1, 0)
derived.yield36: max(floor(910 / short_mm) * floor(1820 / long_mm), floor(910 / long_mm) * floor(1820 / short_mm))
derived.yield48: max(floor(1220 / short_mm) * floor(2440 / long_mm), floor(1220 / long_mm) * floor(2440 / short_mm))
derived.eyelets: if_((media == 'ターポリン') and (no_eyelets == 0), 2 * (ceil(width_mm / 500) + ceil(height_mm / 500)) * qty, 0)
